description: Returns the stored court and tribunal AI instruments that match a task and a forum, using the catalogue rule matcher. With a forum named, guidance for the jurisdiction that is not tagged to that forum is returned apart, in `profession_guidance`; read it too. Court decisions about AI use are listed apart in `related_decisions`; they are not rules. United States: a state or DC (US-TX), or US-FED with federal_court and judge, returns that forum’s stored records grouped, each with whom it binds and its page.

federal_court.description: Optional, with a US forum: one federal district or bankruptcy court (N.D. Tex., SDNY, Bankr. D. Del.) or court of appeals (5th Cir.). With a state it must sit in that state; with US-FED its own records, its circuit and the federal judiciary are returned.

forum.description: A forum code such as ncat or federal-court, or a US state or DC (US-TX) or US-FED. Omit it to be asked which court applies.

judge.description: Optional, with a US forum: a judge’s name. That judge’s stored orders are listed apart.

jurisdiction.description: Optional code: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT or CTH (use CTH for federal forums such as the Federal Court, FCFCOA and the Fair Work Commission). Omit it to be asked. No code is filled in for you.

task.description: The legal task, in a short phrase, with client names removed.

name: find_rules
title: Find court AI rules
